name: search_quizzes
description: Search product discovery quizzes by title and list quiz IDs, public IDs, question counts, and response counts

query.description: Optional text to match against quiz titles

limit.description: Maximum number of quizzes to return (1-25, default 10)

name: search_quiz_responses
description: Search customer quiz submissions by name, email, quiz, or date range

search.description: Customer name or email to search for

quizId.description: Internal quiz ID to filter responses for one quiz

dateFrom.description: Custom range start date (YYYY-MM-DD) when datePreset is custom

dateTo.description: Custom range end date (YYYY-MM-DD) when datePreset is custom

limit.description: Maximum number of responses to return (1-25, default 10)

name: get_quiz_analytics
description: Get quiz performance analytics including total responses, active quizzes, average responses per quiz, and top performing quiz
